items.title: John G. Curran Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: I went to a dance where Oscar Celestan, the Bigsland Band played the fantasy music.

ctx.x: This interview was recorded on Tuesday night, 13th of May, 1958.

Can you give me a name please? My name is John G. Curran. Is it date of birth? November 27th, 1807. Place of birth? From the Rollins. Have you lived in New Orleans all your life? I have, with exception of four years when I went on my way to college. 1925, 1929. When did you first call work? There was a first thing in the old jazz. Well, so far back I can hardly remember. What did, um, you like the music you first said?
